artifacts.summary: Minimal 2-phase plan landing the verified route-(a) carrier construction as a compiled test probe and recording the route decision for the successor S2/S3 task; explicitly excludes the Los lemma and all ultraproduct-construction work.

memory_candidates.content: When a route-selection research task produces a compiled, sorry-free prototype as its evidence, the durable landing place is a test probe (Tests/BimodalTest/**Probe.lean, wired into Tests/BimodalTest.lean), not the FormalSystem/ library. This repo already uses that convention (RayRegionProbe, RegionGateProbe, BoxNegPreservationProbe, UntlSnceCopyProbe). Landing in Tests/ puts the decision under lake build, so a change to the modules it depends on or a Mathlib bump turns the build red instead of silently invalidating a report claim, while avoiding unused library code that the successor task will immediately supersede and avoiding scope creep into the successor's construction work. Second-order gotcha: a prototype verified with bare `lake env lean` has NOT been checked under the target lean_lib's leanOptions (here autoImplicit := false), so promotion always carries an elaboration-fallout risk that must be a named phase-verification item.
